effect.purpose: Read-only Effect v4 source pinned to the tag matching the effect catalog. The authority on what v4 actually exports, plus the v3 to v4 migration notes and the @effect/vitest reference implementation.

orientation.layout: Sparse checkout: packages/effect (core source + package.json exports map), packages/vitest (@effect/vitest reference implementation), migration/ (per-domain v3 to v4 notes), ai-docs/, LLMS.md, MIGRATION.md. Services and tags live in Context.ts; there is no ServiceMap.ts. Context.Key<Id, Shape> extends Effect<Shape, never, Id>, so v4 tags and Service classes are first-class Effects.
orientation.startHere: packages/effect/src settles what v4 actually exports; migration/*.md settles v3 to v4 renames. Before trusting an answer, check the pin matches the installed effect version; node_modules wins on disagreement.
